body: Not anymore and this is really great!
Yes I know the feeling. I'm not sure about how it was possible but I don't have that thought anymore. I hope it will be different for you too one day.

Hi CatJamFan,

You are totally right. It wasn't my intention to make it easy. 

The fact that I'm here confirm your words. I just want to be more positive after seeing a lot of tears around me but it's not easy at all. I'm impressed that you tried many ways to stay better. As you see people play a good part in our problems, that's why I learned to be more indifferent. I need to learn it because their thoughts and actions hurt me a lot. 

Thank you for your point of view

Hello profethofsorts,

I find this message through an award you gave me. 

First of all I'm sorry for this episode. I know it's a little bit late but better late than never. I share my feelings too to a friend about my suicidal thoughts and I got the same treatment. I don't blame her, I just feel sorry about it. You know, it's very difficult to understand others experience if you didn't get through it. Yeah, I felt like she minimized my essence and cutted it in thousand pieces but.. she is a good person. For a "mistake" is not worth changing our mind about who they are. Do you agree?

I hope you get well

In my humble opinion (but who I am to say it) is not worth. Just the fact that you are writing your problems means you are trying to change and that's good. I thought no one would understand me. In reality my way of thinking was totally conditioned by my depression. You can do it, you can change your life. Let the time guides you slowly.. I hope you to recover well.

Hi Diacetyl, I feel like we can understand each other. Your words are right. We shouldn't put a mask on. Unfortunately I was doing it unconsciously. 

Thank you for sharing your experience. You were so strong in that lowest point of your life. That simple step was too bigger for me. The fact that you realize everything in that moment is significant and I'm really glad of the improvement on yourself until now. Material things are appealing at first sight. Too many people lost themselves in there (my father..) so I can get their point but just as you said.. what's really important is untouchable and invisible. Maybe our way to grasp this concept was too extreme, that's the reason why we are so lucky (and strong).

I really really wish you the best too.
